title: Return Noble USDC escrow to the migration multisig and freeze the ixo (Impacthub) USDC voucher
summary: Circle ends USDC support on Noble; the full pause is on 2027-01-12. This proposal returns all Noble USDC vouchers (ibc/6BBE9BD4246F8E04948D5A4EEE7164B2630263B9EBB5E7DC5F0A46C62A2FF97B) still in circulation on ixo (Impacthub) to Noble over channel-26 (MsgReturnToNoble, amount 0 = the full return cap), releasing the matching USDC from Noble escrow to the multisig noble1REPLACE_WITH_MULTISIG. In the same execution it disables bank sends of the voucher, so the holder snapshot is the height emitted by the usdcmigration_return_to_noble event. Holders are repaid off-chain from that snapshot: REPLACE_WITH_REPAYMENT_PLAN_URL.
